title: azes-ui role
text: apps/azes-ui (@azes/azes-ui) is the AZES web design-system living showcase (laboratory), not a product dashboard. Other apps must not depend on @azes/azes-ui. UI comes from @azes/ui-web; icons from @azes/ui-web/icons. Dev port is 7777. Commands: pnpm --filter @azes/azes-ui dev|build|test|lint.

title: azes-ui boot and routing
text: Boot: index.html pre-paint color-scheme → AzesUiProvider → ShowcaseApp with hash router → AzesDashboardLayout → phase/section content. Routing uses hash (#/phase-foundations, etc.), not react-router. Auth pilot route keeps dashboard chrome off.

title: Five catalog phases
text: Catalog phases: phase-foundations (colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows, motion), phase-controls (buttons, inputs, forms, cards, accordion), phase-data (tables, lists, avatars, tooltips, alerts, snackbar, dialogs), phase-shell (layout, app-shell, responsive, navigation, breadcrumbs, menus), phase-platform (settings, navigation engine, form binding, data-grid, azes-table, charts, pilot pages, accessibility). Default phase is phase-foundations.

title: UI platform stack
text: @azes/design-tokens holds primitives with no React. @azes/ui-web provides theme, catalog, settings, navigation, layout, icons, table, data-grid, charts, forms, feedback, locale. apps/azes-ui is the pilot consumer and interactive showcase. There is no @azes/ui-mui package (ADR-010). UI packages never import business API, auth, or Redux.

title: Package graph and imports
text: design-tokens feeds ui-web and ui-native. ui-web subpaths: settings, navigation, layout, icons, table, data-grid, charts, forms, feedback, locale. Apps import @azes/ui-web public exports only — never @azes/ui-web/src/... Apps must not import @mui/* or @emotion/* except ADR-009 exceptions. UI never knows router, permissions, or i18n — apps inject them.

title: Responsive breakpoints
text: Breakpoints: xs 0, sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536 (token breakpointPx, not stock MUI defaults). layoutQuery default lg switches mobile drawer nav to desktop. Mobile-first sx patterns required. xs–md: header 64px + AzesMobileNav; lg+: header 72px with vertical/mini/horizontal nav.

title: Tokens and theme
text: Tokens live in @azes/design-tokens. Theme is createAzesTheme + AzesThemeProvider from CSS vars. AzesUiProvider wraps settings store (azes.settings.v1), theme, snackbar, dialog, side panel. Settings keys include primary, navLayout, navColor, density, direction, fontFamily, container, headerMode. Prefer theme.vars.palette and theme.azes.* — no free hex/rgba in product UI.

title: Tables and feedback
text: Default lists use AzesTable (@azes/ui-web/table). Confirmations use useAzesDialog. Notifications use snackbar via AzesUiProvider. Side panels use AzesSidePanel. Menus use AzesMenu. Empty table copy is global via AzesTableLabelsProvider.

title: Page and feature architecture
text: Product apps use thin pages/<name>/index.tsx and fat features/<name>/ with components, hooks, service (*Api + *Queries), models (zod + mappers). Server state is TanStack Query; Redux only for justified client/global state. Showcase azes-ui is an exception — living catalog, not a full product CRUD app.

title: State ownership
text: SERVER STATE → TanStack Query (@azes/api). CLIENT/UI STATE → Redux Toolkit (@azes/state). Do not put API response caches into Redux. Ephemeral local UI can stay in React state. azes-ui AI chat uses local React state + Vite proxy, not Redux or Query.

title: Monorepo dependency boundaries
text: Allowed: apps → packages. Forbidden: apps → apps; ui-web/ui-native → api or state; utils → react. Shared stable capabilities live in packages/; product logic stays in apps/features.

title: AI assistant scope
text: The showcase AI assistant answers only about the AZES monorepo, @azes/ui-web design system, and apps/azes-ui showcase. It must not invent OpenAPI endpoints, invent token hex values, or answer off-topic general questions. If knowledge pack lacks an answer, say so. NVIDIA calls go through the local Vite proxy at POST /api/ai/chat; the API key never ships to the browser.

title: azes-ui runbook
text: Run showcase: pnpm --filter @azes/azes-ui dev on http://localhost:7777. Components from @azes/ui-web. For AI chat, copy .env.example to .env and set NVIDIA_API_KEY (server-only). Refresh knowledge chunks under server/knowledge when docs change.
